h: The Manna and Shabbos Meals Nourish Complete Faith

p: Now the three meals of Shabbos
as it is written in the pasuk (Shemos 16:25):
in the parshah of the manna.
And why was this alluded to
in the parshah of the manna
that the holiness of eating on Shabbos
is in the aspect of eating the manna;
and we said there is an allusion to this
"They taught it as the measure of the manna,"
and it calls the Shabbos meal
"And at the time that there said to him
the Holy One, blessed be He, to Moshe:
that perfection is found in me,
דְּהָא בְּגִינִי אִשְׁתְּכַח מָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְכוּלֵּי
for on my account the manna is found for Yisrael," etc.
And this is because the manna was
bread that the ministering angels eat,
And it says in the holy Zohar
dew drips from the Holy Ancient One
and all the Field of Holy Apples is blessed;
that flows down to those below,
it says in the holy Zohar
and on the Field of Apples," etc.;
And it says in the holy Zohar
there is given to a person," etc.,
"a soul in which there is all perfection,
they cast aside all their affairs
And the nations laugh at this
אִם כֵּן לֹא יַעֲשׂוּ מְלָאכָה בְּשַׁבָּת
"If so, let them not work on Shabbos,
יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יוֹשְׁבֵי שַׁעַר (תְּהִלִּים סט, יג)
"'Those who sit in the gate talk about me' (Tehillim 69:13):
and all that they toil for
all the days of the week
and from what we spend on Shabbos
there will come to them yet more
as written in the holy Zohar (there):
by what do they merit it?
And this is called complete faith.
And so it was with the manna,
And this is what it said,
since in his merit the manna came.
And this is what is written in the holy Zohar
"'And the manna was like coriander seed,' etc.:
just as the seed of Gad
why did it single out specifically "like the seed of Gad"?
Did not the sons of Reuven too
take their portion across the Jordan?
וְגַם מַה נַּפְקָא מִינָּהּ לָנוּ בָּזֶה
And also, what difference is it to us
that the manna was outside the Land,
comparable to the seed of Gad?
"And he saw the first portion for himself,
for there the portion of the lawgiver is hidden"
And in Midrash Rabbah (Chukas, Bamidbar Rabbah 19:13):
that Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
in order to bring in, in the future,
the whole generation of the wilderness:
as it says, 'And he came with the heads of the people,' etc.;
but rather it will go out with you";
for Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
"Moshe rejoiced in the gift of his portion"
the aspect of the holiness of the manna;
that is, that a person abandon
all the affairs of this world
and be free only for Torah,
and as they were in the wilderness,
in the matters of this world at all.
And this is what is written
in the holy Zohar cited above:
for the holiness of the Land was needed
only after they came to the Land
and engaged in working the land,
and this one to his olive tree";
the holiness of the Land was needed,
so that through the mitzvos of terumos and maasros
and the other mitzvos dependent on the Land
even into the affairs of this world.
all the matters of this world
and has no involvement with them,
then there is no need for the holiness of the Land.
וּפָרַצְתָּ יָמָּה וָקֵדְמָה וְגוֹ׳ (בְּרֵאשִׁית כח, יד)
'And you shall spread out westward and eastward,' etc." (Bereishis 28:14);
the holiness of the Land goes with him.
of the generation of the wilderness,
And had Moshe entered the Land,
even in Eretz Yisrael they would have been
always free for Torah and service,
like the eaters of the manna;
אַךְ לֹא הָיָה עוֹד הַזְּמַן לָזֶה אָז
but the time for this had not yet come then.
And this is what it said:
your following Me in the wilderness,
for then Yisrael were called a bride,
when they went in the wilderness
and abandoned all the matters of this world.
and as written in the Mechilta
that it should be as if

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos Rabbah 25:12 — “… יג): ועל הר סיני ירדת ודברת עמהם, מה כתיב אחריו (נחמיה ט, יד): ואת שבת קדשך הודעת להם, אמר להם הקדוש ברוך הוא לישראל, אם תזכו לשמר שבת מעלה אני …” — “Rabbi Levi said: If Israel observes Shabbat properly, even one day, the son of David25The Messiah. will come. paragraphs.text: Source: Menachos 36a — “אלא כשהוא חולץ, חולץ של ראש ואחר כך חולץ של יד, מנלן? אמר רבה: רב הונא אסברא לי, אמר קרא: ״והיו לטוטפת בין עיניך״, כל זמן שבין עיניך יהו שתים.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 81) — “But from where do we derive the halakha that when he removes his phylacteries, he first removes the phylacteries of the head and afterward he removes the phylacteries of the arm? Rabba said in explanation: Rav Huna explained to me …”
